latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Micro Offer Validation Sprint — a step-by-step guide to test and validate paid micro-offers before building.

- Guides freelancers, consultants, coaches, and creators through a 7-day evidence-based validation sprint.
- Generates hypothesis, interview scripts, simple offer copy, ethical outreach, and objection notes.
- Focuses on disciplined learning with clear decision criteria (go / iterate / stop) after 7 days.
- Safety-first: excludes get-rich-quick claims, spam, high-pressure tactics, and unverified promises.
- Provides a clear, structured output template for documenting each sprint.
